title: Lossless WebP to RGBA pixels
summary: Decode an in-memory lossless (VP8L) WebP file, with transforms, colour cache, backward references and several prefix-code groups, to a width, a height and a buffer of pixel bytes.
notes: Inputs are hex strings, because fixtures are shared as JSON; every adapter turns them into bytes in prepare, before any timing, so the measured call decodes bytes only.
